summary: Implemented A11Y-1 responsive hardening: a shared responsive CSS layer and layout-mode hook, phone bottom sheets for board actions/search/closure/connection detail and card actions/tags, safe-area handling, compact phone board actions, breakpoint-aligned phone styles, 19 component checks including nested-sheet focus behavior, and a Playwright journey covering 390x844, 768x1024, 1280x800, and 1440x900 with overflow, sheet, primary-action, and 44px assertions. Required unit and browser commands, full suite, typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented A11Y-1 responsive hardening: a shared responsive CSS layer and layout-mode hook, phone bottom sheets for board actions/search/closure/connection detail and card actions/tags, safe-area handling, compact phone board actions, breakpoint-aligned phone styles, 19 component checks including nested-sheet focus behavior, and a Playwright journey covering 390x844, 768x1024, 1280x800, and 1440x900 with overflow, sheet, primary-action, and 44px assertions. Required unit and browser commands, full suite, typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.
decisions: Reused the Dialog primitive as the phone bottom sheet instead of forking a visual overlay, so focus trap, Escape, aria-modal, inert siblings, and focus restoration stay in one audited component.
Extended Dialog with a topmost-dialog stack so a confirmation opened from a sheet closes alone and only the topmost overlay handles Escape or redirects focus.
Resolved return-focus targets at close time so selecting a search result or centring a loose card can land focus on the board heading rather than the sheet trigger.
Switched entire side panels between inline and sheet rendering in JavaScript using matchMedia rather than rendering duplicate DOM and hiding one copy with CSS.
Used the existing 1280x800 desktop breakpoint styling for that primary arranging shape; 1280 is above the documented 1200 desktop boundary.
Aligned phone stylesheets to max-width 37.4375rem so exactly 600px is tablet, matching the documented phone-below-600 rule.
interfaces: src/app/useLayoutMode.ts exports PHONE_MAX_QUERY, TABLET_MAX_QUERY, LayoutMode, useLayoutMode(), and usePhoneLayout().
SearchPanel gains an optional variant: 'inline' | 'sheet' prop; inline remains the default.
Dialog keeps its existing public props and adds nested-dialog topmost behavior plus close-time returnFocusRef resolution.
CaseBoardPage internal phone surfaces: Case actions, Search and filters, Case closure, and Connection details sheets.
CardDetailPage internal phone surface: Card actions and tags sheet replacing the inline sidebar below 600px.
agentReportedTests: npm test -- tests/a11y/responsive.test.tsx: exit 0, 19 passed (engine-verified in this task run)
npm run test:e2e -- e2e/responsive.spec.ts: exit 0, 2 passed and 4 intentionally skipped by project scoping (engine-verified in this task run)
npm run lint: exit 0 with 3 pre-existing RecallSummary react-refresh warnings
warnings: Lint retains three pre-existing react-refresh advisories in RecallSummary.tsx; no new lint warnings were introduced.
The 1280x800 tablet-landscape arranging shape deliberately uses desktop tokens because it is above the documented 1200px desktop breakpoint.
Headless Chromium reports safe-area insets as 0px, so notched-device appearance and final sheet height/feel remain human review items.
Board spatial gestures remain pointer-only by design and are not claimed as keyboard-operable.
validationLimitations: Playwright evidence is Chromium-only; Firefox/WebKit smoke remains A11Y-6 scope.
No axe scans were added, per task exclusion.

The viewport matrix runs once in the desktop project while setting all four viewports explicitly; the phone sheet journey runs in the phone project, so tablet and desktop projects report the other journey as skipped by design.
Safe-area presence is verified by a source contract test because the headless browser resolves env() insets to 0px.
payload.taskDescription: Add responsive.css and adjust AppShell, CaseShelf, CaseBoardPage, CardDetailPage, RecallPage, SearchPanel, and SettingsPage for phone below 600px, tablet 600–1199px, and desktop 1200px and up. Use bottom sheets on phone, safe-area insets, a compact board toolbar, and layouts that never cause page-level horizontal scrolling. Preserve every capability at 390x844. Add component and Playwright viewport tests for 390x844, 768x1024, 1280x800, and 1440x900, including sheet open/close and 44px controls. Do not add keyboard shortcuts or axe scans.
